merchant/31443.htm.text: Mineral Trader Raban: Every blacksmith of the kingdom advertises their minerals as the best. Ha ha! Of course, it's all nonsense. Most of them are little better than hacks hoping to play their subpar wares on unsuspecting adventurers...
